title: The Best Mango of the Year

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager has just eaten the best mango of the year: tell everyone, or keep it a secret.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every year there is one mango that's better than all the others. Everyone knows it when they bite into it. Today (subject) bit into it. It was perfect: sweet, soft, fragrant, cold from the morning shade. (subject.He/she) is standing in the orchard holding the stone, looking slightly stunned. (friend) asks what's happened.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "I just had the best mango of the year," says (subject). Word spreads. People come out to the orchard and start trying mangoes, looking for another one like it. Nobody finds one. A few people think (subject) is exaggerating. (subject) knows. (subject.He/she) will remember that mango for the rest of the year.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "Nothing," says (subject), and smiles. (subject.He/she) doesn't tell anyone. All season, (subject.he/she) watches other villagers bite into mangoes, waiting to see if anyone gets that look on their face. Nobody does. It's (subject.his/her) mango. (subject.He/she) had it. That's the end of it, and that's enough.
